summary: The exact candidate independently verifies as a partial fix for DeepSeek-V4.1 C2 boundary-state transfer: legal ring size 2 works, endpoint-local request slots and unequal ring capacities map correctly, even boundaries send no row, and odd boundaries copy exactly one 4096-byte FP32 row per source layer. It does not implement or validate the original issue's complete end-to-end PD + DSpark contract, so changes are requested before treating the original issue as resolved.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on recorded base. The prepared source import rejected the legal non-speculative C2 ring size 2 with ValueError. Evidence: raw/base-import-and-counterexample.log
Candidate regression suite: 93 tests and 17 subtests passed, covering wire helpers, C2 mapping/registration, and Mooncake/NIXL helper behavior. Evidence: raw/candidate-regression-tests.log

Independent cases with different request slots, unequal 2-to-8 rings, odd/even boundaries, wraparound, zero length, and invalid non-power-of-two capacities all matched the issue formula. Evidence: raw/candidate-import-counterexamples.log

One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X copied three 4096-byte FP32 rows using different source/destination request slots and ring capacities. Values matched CPU references exactly and adjacent rows were untouched; total payload 12288 bytes. Evidence: raw/candidate-gpu-independent-row-copy.log
Python byte-compilation of the candidate's changed runtime paths. Evidence: raw/candidate-compileall.log

gpu_evidence: Single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X; Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; HIP 7.2.26015; exact numerical row-copy check in raw/candidate-gpu-independent-row-copy.log.
native_rebuild_reason: No native C/C++/FlyDSL source changed in the candidate; a native rebuild was not applicable.
remaining_counterexamples: No end-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark generation was demonstrated with either Mooncake or NIXL.
Streaming and concurrent request behavior remain unverified.
Chunked prefill and prefix-cache restoration, including odd prefix hits and separation of H from N, remain unverified; decode radix cache is still rejected with speculative decoding.
First draft/verify, partial and full rejection, accepted-token commit, C2 reuse, and Engram-history updates remain unverified end to end.
Cancellation, stale-write prevention, source-release ordering, and request-slot reuse remain unverified.
Generation parity against a non-disaggregated DeepSeek-V4.1 reference, actual speculative acceptance, and throughput remain unmeasured.
The prepared ROCm/MI350X architecture cannot execute DSpark because the implementation explicitly accepts CUDA or NPU only.
No DeepSeek-V4.1 target/draft weights or real multi-process/cross-node Mooncake/NIXL topology were available.
remaining_limitations: Review architecture was AMD Instinct MI350X on ROCm 7.2; DSpark's CUDA/NPU-only guard prevents end-to-end execution here.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is not a valid substitute for DeepSeek-V4.1 architecture or DSpark semantic validation.
Candidate transport evidence is protocol/unit-level rather than real Mooncake and NIXL serving workloads.
No native rebuild was needed because no native source changed.
